profile.description: Amazon Nova Lite is a low‑cost multimodal foundation model from Amazon that can process text, images, and video and is optimized for speed and affordability. It offers a context window of 300,000 tokens, allowing handling of very large inputs in a single request (including up to ~30 minutes of video).
